name: Forward lunge
movement: a step forward, both knees to a right angle, and a push back to standing

phone.placement: Stand the phone up on the floor, leaning on something, two or three metres away, side on to where you will be.

words.hint: Standing side on, a long step forward, both knees to a right angle, and back.
words.start: Stand the phone up on the floor. Stand side on to it, tall, feet together, and step forward into a lunge.
words.position: Stand side on to the phone, tall, feet hip-width, hands on your hips.
words.top: The front thigh level with the front knee over the ankle, the back knee just off the floor, the trunk upright.
howto: Stand tall, hands on your hips. Take a long step forward with the leg nearest the phone.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is level — front knee at a right angle, stacked over the ankle, not drifting past the toes.
The back knee hovers just above the floor; the trunk stays upright with the chest up.
Push through the front heel back to standing. The rep counts there. Do a set on one leg, then the other.
words.cannot: The back knee and the front knee caving inward: it judges the leg nearest the phone — its knee angle, its shin against vertical — and the trunk. Take a long enough step yourself.
words.about: Forward lunge — standing side on, the leg nearest the phone stepping forward: the front knee angle between hip and ankle, 80–100° at the bottom; the front shin, as the knee's lean forward of the ankle, at most 20°, so the knee stays over the ankle; and the trunk within ±15° of vertical. The rep is under way once the front knee bends past 120° and counts when it is straight again past 160°.
words.lost: Step into the camera, side on
words.early: Go all the way down next time
words.safety: Stop if the front knee hurts at the front; take a longer step and keep the shin nearer vertical. Hold a chair for balance if you need to.
words.easier: A shorter drop; a hand on a chair; a pause at the top.
words.harder: Dumbbells at the sides; a slower lowering; a longer pause at the bottom.
words.mistakes: The front knee drifting past the toes; leaning the trunk forward; a short step; not getting the front thigh level.

measurements.why: A right angle at the front knee, ten degrees either way, with the thigh level. Also the progress measurement: the rep is under way past raiseAt and counts back past downAt.

measurements.label: knee ahead of ankle

settings.label: Front knee ahead of the ankle, at most

measurements.why: The front shin off vertical, positive the way the body faces: the knee stacked over the ankle reads near zero; well past the toes reads 30 and more.

measurements.label: trunk off vertical
measurements.why: The hip-to-shoulder line off plumb, positive leaning forward over the front leg.

measurements.label: leg ahead of the hip
measurements.why: Which leg is in front: the ankle ahead of the hip reads positive. Not judged; it picks the front leg.

faults.label: Knee past the ankle
faults.text: Knee back over your ankle — take a longer step
faults.deep: Longer step — the knee is well past your toes

faults.label: Leaning forward
faults.deep: Sit up — you are folding over the front leg

faults.label: Not low enough
faults.text: Lower until the front thigh is level
faults.deep: Drop lower — the back knee toward the floor

faults.label: Too deep
faults.text: Not so deep — thigh level is enough
